name: Can I install a tank water heater myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a tank water heater myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it might seem tempting to install a tank water heater yourself, it is strongly recommended to hire a professional. Proper installation involves complex plumbing, gas, or electrical connections, and adherence to local building codes. Incorrect installation can lead to safety hazards like gas leaks, carbon monoxide poisoning, electrical shorts, water damage, and voided warranties. Professionals ensure the installation is safe, compliant, and efficient, giving you peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional for tank water heater installation is strongly recommended due to complex plumbing, gas/electrical connections, safety hazards, and code compliance.
